item.title: Georgia Southern beats Appalachian State 29-10, wins Birmingham Bowl
item.description: OJ Arnold had 152 yards rushing on 11 carries, Terrance Gibbs and Weston Bryant each had a rushing touchdown, and Georgia Southern beat Appalachian State 29-10 on Monday to win the Birmingham Bowl.
